::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## Publication boundary

The public CVD tables are a Quarto/Observable presentation of approved CVD
event and mortality metric releases. They do not have a separate analytical
workflow.

The page may filter, arrange and format published values and make only the
explicitly documented presentation calculations permitted by its approved
contract. It must not recreate surveillance metrics, change suppression or
infer protected values.

## Source page

```text
site/surveillance/cvd/tables/index.qmd
```

The page reads the approved website-mirror CSVs published by CVD event Step 6
and mortality Step 6. A routine data release should update the tables without a
manual edit to their analytical values.

## After a metric release

1. Confirm the relevant Stata Step 6 completed and the website mirror agrees
   with the authoritative public copy.
2. Preview the tables page and inspect event and mortality coverage separately.
3. Check unavailable, incomplete and protected values are not treated as zero.
4. Test tab controls and table downloads.
5. Run the local-link check and complete site render before deployment.

If a value is wrong, correct the source data or Stata code and rerun the
relevant release workflow. Do not repair a displayed analytical value in QMD or
Observable code.
